headline: We ride a habit that already exists
detail: Owners already hand cash to an agent every day. We move that habit to an app; we do not have to create it.
key_number: 2 lakh+ daily agents in Maharashtra alone, serving about 1 crore families
source: Indian Cooperative, as used in your deck (A8)

headline: The money is safe and stays in the owner's own name
detail: A regulated fund, held in the owner's name, that they can take out any day. A credit society can fail: Sahara's four societies had repaid 27 lakh of their 1.35 crore depositors by Jul 2025.
key_number: 27 lakh of 1.35 crore Sahara depositors repaid by Jul 2025
source: Angel One on Sahara refunds (Jul 2025); SEBI mutual fund master circular (Mar 2026)

headline: We can see all of the owner's money, not one QR's slice
detail: A shop holds about 9 QR codes, so each QR lender sees one slice. All of it lands in the owner's own bank account. With the owner's consent, a lender can read every inflow through the Account Aggregator system. Reading it needs a regulated lender partner, so this is an edge only once we build our credit checks on it.
key_number: about 9 QR codes per merchant (FY25)
source: PIB (Dec 2025), as used in your deck (A25); Sahamati (Sep 2026)

headline: Nothing of ours is at risk at the start
detail: Partner lenders book the loans and the fund house holds the money, so the pilot needs no lending licence and no loan book. Daily fund saving on the exchange has no per-debit fee for us, because the fund house pays it.
key_number: Rs 0 transaction fee for distributors on BSE StAR MF
source: Cafemutual on BSE StAR MF (row XB-01 in your research)

headline: A founder who has run a lending business
detail: Credit checks, collections and lender terms decide whether this model works. The founder has run all three before. Experience like that takes years to copy.
source: Your pitch deck, slide 9

headline: Saving earns us almost nothing
detail: The fund pays us 0.2-0.5% of the balance a year. Over five years savings is Rs 31 of the Rs 542 an owner brings in. Every other product has to pay for the saver.
key_number: Rs 30-75 a year per saver
source: Kotak MF on trail; your model (tables/redesign_deck.csv)

headline: Everything hangs on one number we have not measured
detail: If winning an owner costs Rs 250, each is worth +Rs 180 over five years. At today's evidence of about Rs 500, the same owner is worth -Rs 70. Both assume 1 in 5 borrow each year.
key_number: +Rs 180 at Rs 250 to win; -Rs 70 at Rs 500
source: Your model (tables/redesign_grid.csv)

headline: Referring a loan earns a fraction of lending it
detail: On a Rs 2 lakh loan we would earn Rs 2,000-5,000, once. PhonePe earned about Rs 14,600 on the same amount, because it also collects. Partner loans are about 80% of our revenue, so lenders' appetite decides our income.
key_number: Rs 2,000-5,000 vs about Rs 14,600 per Rs 2 lakh loan
source: GroMo agent payouts (Aug 2026); Business Today on PhonePe (Mar 2026)

headline: We have no grip on repayment, and we cannot take cash
detail: QR lenders cut the instalment from the shop's daily sales before paying it out. We would collect by bank mandate, and daily debits fail often. We also cannot do the agent's best trick: collect cash at the counter.
key_number: 55-90% of AutoPay attempts failed at major banks (Aug 2025)
source: Mint on NPCI data (Sep 2025)

headline: We start late, small, and with the same product
detail: Bachatt launched in May 2025 and has raised $16M. PhonePe's Daily SIP starts at Rs 10 a day; our plan says Rs 100. Same funds, same UPI AutoPay.
key_number: $1M ask vs Bachatt's $16M; Rs 100 vs Rs 10 minimum
source: Bachatt Series A release (Mar 2026); Angel One on PhonePe Daily SIP (Dec 2025)

headline: Growth eats cash before it pays
detail: In year one an owner brings in +Rs 119 but costs Rs 250 to win: -Rs 131 at month 12, paid back by month 21. Each extra owner won means more cash out first. The team is still to be hired.
key_number: -Rs 131 per owner at month 12; payback month 21
source: Your model (tables/redesign_year1.csv); pitch deck slide 9

headline: Only about 4 in 10 small businesses have formal credit
detail: 41% of small-business borrowers had an active formal loan in March 2026. Borrowing is the biggest gap in their money life, and it is the product that pays.
key_number: 41% with an active formal loan (Mar 2026)
source: TransUnion CIBIL-SIDBI MSME Pulse (Jul 2026)

headline: Online business lenders are pulling back
detail: Lendingkart cut its loan book 74% in FY26 and NeoGrowth about 21%, after bad loans rose. Small-business credit overall still grew 12.8%. Owners are being turned away, and lenders want borrowers who are already screened.
key_number: Lendingkart loan book -74% in FY26
source: StartupFeed (5 Oct 2026), citing filings and CRIF High Mark

headline: No digital player has shown that saving earns owners a loan
detail: 'Save with us, borrow from us' works at credit co-op societies, but they are uninsured and some fail. Bachatt says it uses saving behaviour to lend, but has published no loan numbers. The first to prove it owns the story.
key_number: 2 lakh credit co-op societies in India
source: PIB Ministry of Cooperation (2025); Bachatt site; your deck (A16)

headline: Nobody saves a slice of the day's sales yet
detail: We found no product at Paytm, PhonePe, BharatPe or Pine Labs that saves part of a shop's daily takings. An amount that follows sales fits uneven income better than a fixed Rs 100.
key_number: none found (search, Sep 2026)
source: Your research (row NG-046); deck A45

headline: Lending on the whole bank account is going mainstream
detail: Bank-data sharing with consent (Account Aggregator) backed Rs 3.82 lakh crore of loans in FY26: 8.4% of retail and small-business lending by value. The pipes to lend on all of an owner's inflows exist now.
key_number: Rs 3.82 lakh crore of loans in FY26
source: Sahamati (2 Sep 2026)

headline: Owners want fast, secured credit: gold loans tripled in three years
detail: Gold loans grew from Rs 6.3 to Rs 19.4 lakh crore (Mar 2023 to Mar 2026). The average loan is Rs 1.96 lakh and 3 in 4 go to repeat borrowers, more and more for shop working capital. Gold-loan and loan-against-fund partners are an easy first loan to sell.
key_number: Rs 19.4 lakh crore gold-loan book (Mar 2026)
source: Experian India via Moneylife (Jun 2026)

headline: Later: lending ourselves turns a loss into a profit
detail: Referring loans, an owner is worth -Rs 54 over five years at today's Rs 499 to win. Lending ourselves: +Rs 205 at normal losses, +Rs 859 if savers repay better. RBI's co-lending rules (Jan 2026) need us to keep only 10% of each loan.
key_number: -Rs 54 refer vs +Rs 205 to +Rs 859 lend
source: Your model (tables/lend_customer.csv); RBI co-lending rules via Business Standard

headline: PhonePe can join the dots
detail: It has 5 crore+ registered shops, a Daily SIP from Rs 10 with 5 lakh+ investors, loans against mutual funds, and Rs 4,507 crore of shop loans (FY25) repaid from daily sales. The one piece it lacks, saving from sales, is a feature it could ship.
key_number: 5 crore+ shops; 5 lakh+ Daily SIP investors
source: PhonePe press (Apr 2026); Outlook Business (3 Aug 2026); Business Today (Mar 2026)

headline: Bachatt is about 17 months ahead on the same play
detail: Daily saving for shop owners, loans up to Rs 5 lakh through 7 lenders, paid agents who sign up savers, and $16M raised with Accel leading. It claims 3M users.
key_number: $16M raised; 3M users (company claim)
source: Bachatt Series A release (Mar 2026); Entrackr

headline: Lenders are getting stricter with small businesses
detail: The same pullback as O2 means partner lenders approve fewer loans and push fees down. RBI caps any first-loss cover we give a lender at 5% of the loans.
key_number: first-loss cover capped at 5% of loans
source: Crisil Ratings (Nov 2025) via StartupFeed; RBI Digital Lending Directions (May 2025)

headline: Savers stop, debits fail, and leaving takes one tap
detail: Over a third (35.6%) of SBI's Rs 250 daily SIPs opened in FY26 had stopped by April 2026. Since Dec 2025 any UPI app can show a person's AutoPay mandates and move them.
key_number: 35.6% of small daily SIPs stopped within the year
source: Business Standard citing SBI Funds' RHP (Jul 2026); NPCI OC-223

headline: New rules can shrink what each product earns
detail: IRDAI's draft caps insurance commissions (15% on a first-year health policy, less on insurance sold with a loan); comments close 25 Oct 2026. No cashback or gifts on fund saving. An NBFC of our own needs Rs 10 crore of its own capital.
key_number: 15% cap on first-year health commission (draft)
source: IRDAI consultation (23 Sep 2026) via Khaitan & Co; AMFI code of conduct; RBI

headline: Owners already have fast credit elsewhere
detail: Gold loans need no income proof, and from Apr 2026 lend up to 85% of the gold's value on loans under Rs 2.5 lakh. Payment apps pre-approve shop loans from sales data. Our loan has to be better than these, not just available.
key_number: up to 85% of gold value on loans under Rs 2.5 lakh
source: RBI gold and silver loan directions (Jun 2025), as reported Apr-May 2026
